messages:
Nina: Sharing quick mock for compact pool controls — goal: surface burst and cost without expanding panel. PTAL.

Ravi: Nice! But burst knob is easy to miss. Maybe show a tiny rocket icon next to the label + focus outline. :rocket:

Lena: Copy: replace "Burst" with "Burst capacity (temporary)" and add a help link. Also show unit: "GPUs" after numeric steppers.

Tom: Cost preview: show a muted line "Est. cost/hr: $1.23" that updates on pause (300ms). Make it aria-live polite.

A11yBot: Keyboard order check: pool select -> min stepper -> max stepper -> burst toggle -> slo slider -> save. Add role="switch" and aria-checked on burst.

Nina: Agreed. I'll update the mock: add rocket icon, expanded help on hover, debounce cost, and ARIA attributes. Will post new link shortly.

Ravi: Also flag analytics: emit event when users toggle burst and when they change min more than 3 times in 60s. Could be usability signal.

Nina: Great call — adding to tickets. Thanks all! :thumbsup:
